paragraphs: Nominal Quaternion/V3 values, named ChordPair data and checked callback contracts preserve the original formulas and sample density. Renderer boundaries convert points to xyz lists. Cycloid and chord use separate state branches. The 237-definition check, all 26 public project definitions and the full strict gate (235 reachable definitions) pass. Old Option helpers use method calls or explicit matching at heterogeneous state boundaries; literal case-default branches use match, identity wo-log wrappers are removed, and the store uses defref. Checked decoders remain in place. Twelve unresolved…

For this upgrade, an ignored math probe passes five assertions under the old 0.29.3/formal module graph and new 0.30.0/formal graph in native mode, and under the new graph in an actual browser: 600 cycloid segments, first xyz point, 41 chord points and both endpoints. The formulas, branch bodies, sample parameters and metadata of 13 math definitions were compared through official query views. The original project has no attached test suite. Its browser entry starts without errors; the original production scale/camera leave the scene very small. The older migration's…

VITEBASEURL selects the CDN asset base, defaulting to relative paths. Actions uses Node 24, immutable dependencies and the complete strict gate. Same-repository PR uploads have isolated run/attempt prefixes. COS v1.2.0 checks every uploaded file through public-base-url, without a separate verifier. Only main deploys to the unchanged rsync destination. Local CDN builds and workflow lint pass. PR Actions/COS must be verified for the exact submitted commit; production deployment requires separate authorization and is not part of the local acceptance above.
